file.content:
OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content

The full suite is green. Here's what I implemented.

## Summary

The change enforces that `POST /api/owners` rejects a body missing or blank in any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone`, responding **400** with a JSON `errors` array naming each offending field.

**Why the existing code didn't already do this:** the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` carries `@NotNull @Size(min = 1)` on these fields, but `@Size(min = 1)` accepts whitespace-only values (so a blank `city`/`address` slipped through), and a genuinely missing field threw `MethodArgumentNotValidException`, whose handler emits a `schemaValidationErrors` ProblemDetail — not the required `errors` array.

**Changes (following the OfficeFloor function-injection conventions in AGENTS.md):**

1. **`ValidateOwnerFields`** (new first step of the POST pipeline) — binds `@RequestBody` *without* `@Valid`, explicitly flags each null/blank required field, folds in the remaining schema constraints (pattern, max-length) via an injected `jakarta.validation.Validator`, and throws `MissingOwnerFieldsException(List<String>)` if any field is bad. Otherwise it republishes the body via `Out<OwnerFieldsDto>`.
2. **`MissingOwnerFieldsException`** (checked) + **`MissingOwnerFieldsExceptionHandler`** — the handler responds 400 with `errors` set to the field names, wired through `officefloor/escalation/…MissingOwnerFieldsException.yml`.
3. **`BuildOwner`** — now consumes the published body via `@Val OwnerFieldsDto` instead of binding `@RequestBody` (only one step per pipeline may bind the body).
4. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted the `validate` step ahead of `build`.

Binding the body without `@Valid` in the validate step is deliberate: it routes missing fields to this rule's `errors` response rather than the generic schema-validation escalation, while the programmatic `Validator` call keeps pattern/length rejection intact.

Results: `Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — `errorRejectsMissingCity`, `errorRejectsBlankTelephone`, and `functionalityAcceptsCompleteOwner` all pass, and the full build is green.
